task-agents.title: Local Task Agents
task-agents.subtitle: Create, manage, and run custom task agents stored on this device.

unsupported.title: Desktop only
unsupported.description: Local task agents are backed by Tauri commands and only available inside the desktop app.

library.title: Agent Library
library.description: Search and switch between your local task agents.
library.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, description, prompt, or tags...
library.draftDescription: You are editing a new task agent that has not been saved yet.
library.emptyDescription: Create your first task agent to start building repeatable local workflows.

starter.title: Choose what you want to create
starter.description: Start with the agent type, then move into a dedicated creation workspace designed for that role.

chat.title: Chat Task Agent
chat.description: A collaborative agent for chat work, task execution, and capability orchestration.

features.chat: Shape how the agent behaves in chat and what work it should own.
features.skills: Bind local skills and MCP tools only when this agent truly needs them.

image.title: Image Agent
image.description: A focused visual role for chat `@` invocation, style tuning, and image preview.

features.invoke: Tune the prompt, style, and output defaults for a reusable image role.
features.preview: Keep the experience visual-first without exposing generic tool bindings.

voice.title: Voice Agent
voice.description: A focused audio role for turning text into speech inside chat.

features.invoke: Define reusable voice defaults and let chat trigger speech generation on demand.
features.preview: Return audio output as a chat block instead of creating a separate voice workflow.

editor.newDescription: Define the task, bind the right tools and skills, then save before previewing.

chatWorkspace.title: Create Chat Task Agent
chatWorkspace.description: Configure a collaborative chat agent with the right identity, prompt, and capability bindings.

imageWorkspace.title: Create Image Agent
imageWorkspace.description: Configure a focused image agent for style control, output defaults, and visual preview.

voiceWorkspace.title: Create Voice Agent
voiceWorkspace.description: Configure a focused voice agent for speech defaults and audio preview.

basic.title: Agent Identity
basic.description: Name the agent and define how it should behave.

model.title: Model Routing
model.description: Keep the common fields easy to edit, while still preserving advanced JSON config.

placeholders.name: e.g. Release Notes Drafter
placeholders.description: What this agent is good at and when you should use it.
placeholders.taskPrompt: You are a delegated local task agent. Focus on...

modelConfig.helper: Basic model fields above override overlapping keys inside the JSON block when you save.
modelConfig.invalidJson: Model config JSON must be a valid object.

imageConfig.title: Image Defaults
imageConfig.description: Set the default image-generation parameters this task agent should reuse for every run.
imageConfig.helper: These structured fields are written into model_config.image_generation and override overlapping keys inside the advanced JSON when you save.
imageConfig.invalidExtraParamsJson: Image extra params JSON must be a valid object.

placeholders.negativePrompt: Things the agent should avoid generating by default.

helpers.allowTextOnly: Allow this image agent to run even when the user does not upload any reference image.

voiceConfig.title: Voice Defaults
voiceConfig.description: Set the default speech parameters this task agent should reuse for every run.
voiceConfig.helper: These structured fields are written into model_config.text_to_speech and override overlapping keys inside the advanced JSON when you save.
voiceConfig.invalidExtraParamsJson: Voice extra params JSON must be a valid object.

toggles.discoverable: Allow this agent to be indexed and surfaced for local discovery.
toggles.enabled: Disable this agent to keep it out of preview and execution.
toggles.preferredForImageGeneration: When enabled on an image agent, the worker branch will prefer this agent for image requests.

bindings.title: Bindings Catalog
bindings.description: Task agents can only call explicitly bound tools and locally installed skills.
bindings.toolsDescription: Choose the local MCP tools this agent may call.
bindings.skillsDescription: Only locally installed skills can be bound here.
bindings.searchToolsPlaceholder: Search tools by name, id, or status...
bindings.searchSkillsPlaceholder: Search skills by id, version, or runtime...
bindings.noFilteredTools: No tools match the current filter.
bindings.noFilteredSkills: No skills match the current filter.

preview.title: Live Preview
preview.description: Run the saved agent against a test message and inspect its full local response.

placeholders.message: Describe the task you want this agent to handle...

preview.unsavedDescription: Save the draft first. Preview requires a persisted local task agent ID.
preview.emptyDescription: Run a preview to inspect the answer, reasoning, tool calls, and raw payload.

debug.title: Debug Snapshot
debug.description: Review the exact local payload that will be persisted and the runtime inputs currently configured.
